summary: Instance group policies auto-assign new instances with policy_instance_percentage (0-100 of active instances), policy_instance_minimum (at least N instances, or all if fewer exist) and policy_instance_list (fixed instance names); the Instance Groups list shows resulting capacity.
questions: How do I make new instances join an instance group automatically?

answer_card.title: Instance group policy fields
answer_card.answer_md:
- `policy_instance_percentage` (0-100): keep at least this share of active instances in the group.
- `policy_instance_minimum`: keep at least this many instances; if fewer exist, all are added.
- `policy_instance_list`: instance names that are always in the group.

Policies are evaluated each time a new instance comes online.
